dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 你好，请问王明在哪个病房？
dialogue.reading: Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn Wáng Míng zài nǎge bìngfáng?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 他昨天晚上来急诊，现在在三零二病房。
dialogue.reading: Tā zuótiān wǎnshang lái jízhěn, xiànzài zài sān líng èr bìngfáng.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 太好了！还有，牙医在几楼？
dialogue.reading: Tài hǎo le! Hái yǒu, yáyī zài jǐ lóu?
